issues_resolved: Chinese semantic errors in -V quiet-mode cancellation, file-descriptor caps, section ordering, timer/glitch descriptions and TLS name verification.
French semantic/terminology errors in PFS, swap, ticket lifetime, unsigned counters, retries/timeouts, cache eligibility and CPU comparisons.
Untranslated Chinese/French explanatory fences; Chinese supplementary unfenced/indented descriptions and short labels (72 units on 4 pages).
Cross-manual and RFC links routed to the wrong same-numbered local chapters.

Pinned-source errata in IPv6 aliases, privileged-port capability, socket access, date, OCSP spelling, ticket key units, counter widths, rate arrays, map methods, server-ID hashing and health-check SNI.
Obsolete multiprocess guidance explicitly marked for this edition.
Copyable examples restored: FastCGI, SMTP, redirects, ACLs, peers, bandwidth-filter usage, socket-stats alternatives, conditionals and numbered log layouts.
Generator preserves code-fence languages and directive colon spacing.
Publication gates expose translated explanation fences and indented prose to English screening while protecting literal code/output.
Independent source HTML witness and ordered literal checks reject simultaneous HTML/print paragraph, heading and code omissions.
review_boundaries: Automated parity, numeric/literal/signature preservation and English screening support the recorded semantic review scope. Current review covers selected version deltas, security/default/limit/CLI/logging semantics and the corrected French/Chinese passages; unchanged prior review provenance is retained. This is not a new sentence-by-sentence reread of every unchanged paragraph.

The documentation edition is 3.4.6-66 at commit 16acce1dac1dcf1ad5d654204af3a5d45d0e3de8; the latest stable package release is 3.4.6. The three raw manuals at the current maintenance-branch head were independently downloaded and hash-compared.
Source, generated outputs and browser acceptance are local. Git delivery and live deployment require separate verification.

runtime_behavior_checks: JWT none rejected by default and accepted with explicit opt-in
hex2i invalid input yields no sample instead of zero
url_ip and url_port fail on host names without resolution
show events -s sanitizes bytes without changing byte length
